people.name: Designer
people.description: Lays out screens and graphics, styles, reuses and exports them.

systems.name: creative-apps
systems.description: Design's part of the suite: its Model, its App and the SuiteUI it builds on.

containers.name: DesignModel
containers.description: Linux-safe state, logic and use cases behind Design's window. Foundation and CoreColor only, value types.

components.name: Workspace
components.description: DesignWorkspace: the open file's pages, the selected page and layers (DesignSelection), expanded rows, tool, text edit, file URL, held-id index (DesignHeldIDs), the marquee rectangle (D0-1) and the services it runs on (D0-2). Every document edit lands here as one named undo step.

components.name: Node tree
components.description: DesignNode, DesignPage, DesignRect, DesignColor and the tree walks (rows, ancestors, hit, add, remove). D0-1 adds corner radius, opacity, stroke and text style; D2-1 adds the path kind, path and component reference.

components.name: History
components.description: Model-owned undo and redo: one snapshot per named step, coalescing runs, New File swaps; F5 adds the saved marker behind the unsaved dot and the close prompt.

components.name: Canvas gestures
components.description: drag(from:to:modifiers:) and endDrag routed to the tool: hit testing, handles, move, resize, nudge, delete, draw, text placement and inline text. D0-3 adds the marquee (a drag on a frame's empty background selects inside it), several-layer and Option-drag routes through the services.

components.name: Inspector logic
components.description: What the inspector and Layers rows show and why a control is off: header lines, locks, eye and lock toggles, align to frame or page, corner radius for one layer (DesignCorners, from #753).

components.name: File codec
components.description: Design's JSON file: all-or-nothing open, same bytes for the same document, a reason per refusal. F5 moves the codec into Live/LiveFiling.swift behind DocumentFiling.

components.name: Use-case contracts
components.description: One protocol per use case (marquee, transform, align, duplicate, group, clipboard, ordering, style, framing, filing, export, pen, components, variables), DesignEdit, DesignRefusal, DesignIDMint and the style and tier-2 value types. Linux-safe.

components.name: Services and actions
components.description: DesignServices (.live and .fake), NotBuilt, and the workspace methods that run a use case and apply its DesignEdit as one undo step (DesignActions), with the help string each control shows.

components.name: Fixture fakes and fixtures
components.description: A fake per use case and the named fixture documents snapshots and journeys launch on (-DesignServices fake, -DesignFixture <name>).

components.name: Live conformances
components.description: The real use cases, one file each, swapped into DesignServices.live by the feature that builds them.

containers.name: DesignApp
containers.description: The SwiftUI app on SuiteUI's EditorShell. Reads DesignModel and sends it intents; never writes its state.

components.name: Window shell
components.description: DesignApp scene, DesignWindow (the one model, presentation state, perform for every intent, launch arguments), DesignEditor (top bar, rail, status line), DesignIntent and DesignControls (the suite.controls list for the every-control journey).

components.name: Canvas
components.description: DesignCanvas on CanvasViewport, artwork painting (DesignCanvasMarks), selection marks and the marquee (DesignSelectionMarks, split out in D0-5b), frame names in the unclipped overlay (DesignFrameLabels) and the inline text editor.

components.name: Panel
components.description: Properties and Layers tabs: DesignPanel, DesignInspector, the Align row, the style sections (DesignInspectorStyle, F3), the Layers list and, in wave 3, the Assets section.

components.name: Menus
components.description: The menu bar: File, Edit (DesignEditMenu from D0-6), Page, Object (Align, Distribute, Arrange, Group), View; every top bar command is also here.

components.name: Pasteboard bridge
components.description: Moves the clipboard use case's bytes to and from the system pasteboard under Design's type; the canvas and Layers copy and paste hooks call it.

components.name: Export sheet and rasterizer
components.description: File > Export sheet; renders PNG and PDF from the same artwork view the canvas draws; writes the SVG text the Model makes.

components.name: Pen marks
components.description: The pen draft's anchors and handles over the canvas.

components.name: Variables sheet
components.description: The Variables sheet (Name, Light, Dark) and the canvas mode switch.

containers.name: SuiteUI
containers.description: Shared design system. Design needs: a new CanvasViewport "show a document rect" input (F1), #333 journey files, #330 frame probe, #331/#332 goldens, #589 group rows, #577/#108/#73 sidebar rename and context menus, #339 save status, #706 point mark.

containers.name: Design journeys
containers.description: XCUITest journeys UITests/DesignJourneyTests*.swift (one file per feature once #333 lands) and the app audit.

components.name: Journey files
components.description: One XCTestCase file per feature area.

containers.name: CoreColor library
containers.description: Color spaces and conversions; Design's only engine dependency today.

containers.name: Shared path geometry
containers.description: Needs a new core issue: a Linux-safe path type (move, line, cubic, close) with exact curve bounds, hit test within a tolerance and SVG path data, shared by Flare and Design. The Pen tool (wave 3) waits on it.
